active_itinerary.travel_context:
Costa Rica has bewilderingly diverse culture, climates, flora, and fauna, and landscapes range from rainforests, to dry tropical and temperate forests, to volcanoes, to Caribbean and Pacific beaches, to high mountains, and marshy lowlands. Costa Rica is an exceptionally stable and peaceful country compared to the volatile region it's in, and is one of the world's top destinations for nature and ecotourism. Owing in part to its comparative wealth, it can be a bit more expensive than its northern neighbors in Central America.  


== Regions ==


== Cities ==

Due to Costa Rica's topography and historical development, most economic growth has been concentrated in the Central Valley, which has four cities: San José (capital), Alajuela, Cartago and Heredia. Provincial capitals (Liberia, Puntarenas and Limón) and other towns with strategic locations have regional importance, especially for tourism. Some of Costa Rica's most important cities for travellers are:

1 San José – the capital
2 Alajuela – location of Juan Santamaría International Airport
3 Cartago – Costa Rica's first capital
4  San Ramón – a Center for Agriculture and Tourism in Costa Rica
5 Heredia – coffee plantations
6 Jacó – the...

itinerary.overview: A family-friendly, relaxed 19-day trip to Costa Rica focused on volcanoes, beaches, and La Fortuna's famous water springs. Includes key fixed commitments in San Jose, Palmares, and Escazu.
itinerary.travel_notes: Prepare for varied weather—tropical and cooler in the Central Valley and around volcanoes. Budget around $3000 USD; prioritize local transport and affordable dining. The trip is designed for a relaxed pace with activities suitable for families. December and January are festive seasons with special local events.

daily_plan.title: Arrival and Relaxation in San Jose
activities: Arrive in San Jose, settle into family-friendly accommodation.
Relax and explore Parque Central de San José for a gentle introduction to the city.
Enjoy dinner at a nearby family-friendly restaurant such as La Terraza or Choko.

daily_plan.title: San Jose Birthday Party and City Exploration
activities: Attend the birthday party in San Jose as a fixed commitment.
Explore local landmarks near Parque Central if time allows: Al Trabajador, Juan Pablo II.
Dine at Spoon or a restaurant near the party venue to keep meals easy and comfortable.

daily_plan.title: Travel to La Fortuna and Visit Hot Springs
activities: Travel from San Jose to La Fortuna (approx. 3 hours drive).
Relax at one of La Fortuna's famous hot springs to unwind, such as Baldi Hot Springs or Eco Termales.
Have dinner at a local restaurant like Soda La Parada to experience local flavors.

daily_plan.title: Explore Arenal Volcano and Surroundings
activities: Visit Arenal Volcano National Park for easy hikes and volcano views suitable for families.
Explore Parque de La Fortuna and enjoy some relaxed green spaces.
Dinner at a family-friendly restaurant such as Nanku Restaurant.

daily_plan.title: La Fortuna Waterfalls and Cafe Visit
activities: Visit the La Fortuna Waterfall and enjoy a swim or picnic.
Relax at a nearby cafe like Fresh Dayz or Fusión Chocolate for a treat.
Evening at leisure with optional visit to local shops or stroll through town.

daily_plan.title: Relaxed Beach Day Near La Fortuna or Travel Towards Coast
activities: Consider an easy day with a visit to a nearby beach or water-oriented attraction.
Alternatively, start travel towards the Pacific coast region with stops at scenic points.
Dinner along the way or back in La Fortuna depending on chosen route.

daily_plan.title: Travel Back to Central Valley and San Jose Area
activities: Return travel to San Jose or nearby town (Escazu) for ease of access to next commitments.
Light activities and relaxation, visit Parque Central de San José if missed earlier.
Prepare for upcoming Christmas events.

daily_plan.title: Christmas Eve Dinner in San Jose
activities: Attend the fixed commitment Christmas Eve dinner in San Jose.
Daytime can be spent relaxing or light sightseeing around San Jose or Escazu.

daily_plan.title: Christmas Party in Palmares
activities: Travel to Palmares for the Christmas party fixed commitment.
Enjoy a festive day and return to San Jose or nearby accommodation in the evening.

daily_plan.title: Recovery and Leisure Day Post Parties
activities: Rest day for family to recover from festivities.
Explore local parks or visit cafes around Escazu to relax.
Optional light sightseeing or shopping in Escazu town.

daily_plan.title: New Year's Eve Party in Escazu
activities: Attend the fixed commitment New Year's Eve party in Escazu.
Daytime can include final local sightseeing or relaxation in parks like Parque Central de Escazú.

daily_plan.title: New Year's Day Lunch in San Jose
activities: Attend the fixed commitment lunch in San Jose.
Day for leisurely activities or light family-friendly sightseeing.

daily_plan.title: Leisure Day in San Jose/Day trip Option
activities: Free day to explore museums, parks or cafes in San Jose.
Optional day trip outside San Jose to nearby attractions suitable for families.

daily_plan.title: Travel to Volcano Region for Nature and Relaxation
activities: Travel again to a volcano region near La Fortuna or other to enjoy family-friendly outdoor nature.
Visit easy hiking trails and local natural sights.

daily_plan.title: Beach Day at Pacific Coast
activities: Day trip to a beach on the Pacific Coast for family relaxation and water activities.
Enjoy local seafood dining at a beachfront restaurant.

daily_plan.title: Explore More Volcano or Nature Sites
activities: Visit other volcano parks or natural reserves in the region.
Family-friendly guided nature tours or wildlife observation.

daily_plan.title: Return to Escazu for Final Days
activities: Travel back to Escazu for the last days of the trip.
Light activities and preparation for trip's end.

daily_plan.title: Packing Day in Escazu
activities: Attend the fixed commitment packing day in Escazu.
Relax and organize for departure.

daily_plan.title: Departure from Costa Rica
activities: Prepare for departure from Costa Rica.
Travel to airport and fly home.

itinerary.overview: Explore the rich food culture of Costa Rica in San José and surrounding locations over 3 days, including visits to local family in Escazu, San Jose, Palmares, and Santa Ana, plus a trip to La Fortuna for volcano and nature experience, and a beach visit.
itinerary.travel_notes: Costa Rica offers a mix of vibrant culinary scenes and stunning natural attractions. Your itinerary balances food exploration with cultural and family visits, along with outdoor experiences including volcano trips and beach relaxation. Budget allows for a comfortable and varied experience with local dining and excursions.

daily_plan.title: Arrival, Family Visit in Escazu and San José Food Introduction
activities: Arrive in San José and settle into your accommodation.
Visit family in Escazu to connect and experience local life.
Explore Parque Central de San José for a leisurely walk and local atmosphere.
Dine at La Terraza restaurant in San José to experience authentic Costa Rican dishes.

daily_plan.title: La Fortuna Volcano and Food Exploration
activities: Travel to La Fortuna, home to the Arenal Volcano.
Visit Parque de La Fortuna and nearby volcano sights for nature and scenic views.
Lunch at Soda La Parada or Orgánico Fortuna for local cuisine near Fortuna.
Return towards Palmares for family visit or dining.
Dinner in Palmares area at a local restaurant such as Restaurante La Lira.

daily_plan.title: Beach Trip, Family Visits in Santa Ana, and San José Food Finale
activities: Morning beach trip on the Pacific Coast (suggest nearby beach accessible from the Central Valley).
Visit family in Santa Ana and Palmares for local cultural experience and lunch.
Return to San José for a final local food experience with coffee at Tostador and dinner at Vishnu restaurant.
Spare time for souvenirs or local shopping before departure.
